```{r setup}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = F,

```

```{r 1}

rm(list = ls())

knit_start_time <- Sys.time()

source("../scripts/00_setup.R")

pacman::p_load(
  nhdplusTools,
  sf,
  tidyverse,
  viridis,
  terra,
  geodata
)

theme_set(theme_bw())

dir_data <- "../data/processed"
dir_figs <- "../figures"

huc_level <- "huc08"
huc_col <- str_replace(huc_level, "huc0", "huc")

month_levels <- month.abb

path_metrics <- file.path(dir_data, paste0("06_", huc_level, "_allometry_metrics.csv"))
path_diagnostics <- file.path(dir_data, paste0("06_", huc_level, "_diagnostics.csv"))
path_flowlines <- file.path(dir_data, "riv_pfaf_7_MERIT_Hydro_v07_Basins_v01_CONUS.shp")

```

```{r 2}

metrics <- read_csv(path_metrics, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  mutate(
    huc = str_pad(as.character(huc), width = 8, pad = "0"),
    month = factor(month, levels = month_levels),
    metabolism = recode(
      metabolism_var,
      c_gpp_flux_gO2_d = "GPP",
      c_er_flux_gO2_d = "ER"
    )
  )

diagnostics <- read_csv(path_diagnostics, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  mutate(huc = str_pad(as.character(huc), width = 8, pad = "0"))

allometry <- metrics |>
  inner_join(diagnostics, by = c("huc_level", "huc")) |>
  filter(
    n >= 30,
    r2 >= 0.8,
    is.finite(slope)
  )

annual_slopes <- allometry |>
  group_by(huc, metabolism) |>
  summarise(
    annual_slope = median(slope, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_r2 = mean(r2, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_months = n_distinct(month),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  filter(n_months >= 6)

```

### How do allometric slopes compare?

**My read:** GPP scaling slopes varies more than ER

```{r 3}

p_annual_density <- annual_slopes |>
  ggplot(aes(x = annual_slope, fill = metabolism, color = metabolism)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.35, linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey35") +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "D", end = 0.85) +
  scale_color_viridis_d(option = "D", end = 0.85) +
  labs(
    title = "Annual HUC8 allometric scaling slopes",
    x = "Median annual allometric slope",
    y = "Density",
    fill = "Flux",
    color = "Flux"
  ) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )

p_annual_density

ggsave(
  file.path(dir_figs, "07_annual_huc08_slope_density.png"),
  p_annual_density,
  width = 7,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 300
)

```

### How do allometric slopes compare by season?

**My read:** GPP=ER in winter, ER and GPP separate during summer and fall

```{r 4}

seasonal_allometry <- allometry |>
  mutate(
    season = case_when(
      month %in% c("Dec", "Jan", "Feb") ~ "Winter",
      month %in% c("Mar", "Apr", "May") ~ "Spring",
      month %in% c("Jun", "Jul", "Aug") ~ "Summer",
      month %in% c("Sep", "Oct", "Nov") ~ "Fall"
    ),
    season = factor(season, levels = c("Winter", "Spring", "Summer", "Fall"))
  )

p_seasonal_density <- seasonal_allometry |>
  ggplot(aes(x = slope, fill = metabolism, color = metabolism)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.35, linewidth = 0.75) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey45") +
  facet_wrap(~ season, nrow = 2) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "D", end = 0.85) +
  scale_color_viridis_d(option = "D", end = 0.85) +
  labs(
    title = "Seasonal HUC8 allometric scaling slopes",
    x = "Allometric slope",
    y = "Density",
    fill = "Flux",
    color = "Flux"
  ) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )

p_seasonal_density

ggsave(
  file.path(dir_figs, "07_seasonal_huc08_slope_density.png"),
  p_seasonal_density,
  width = 8,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300
)

```

```{r 6}

flowlines_sf <- read_sf(path_flowlines) |>
  clean_names()

huc_boundaries <- nhdplusTools::get_huc(
  AOI = st_as_sfc(st_bbox(flowlines_sf)),
  type = huc_level,
  t_srs = 4326
) |>
  clean_names() |>
  mutate(
    huc = str_pad(as.character(.data[[huc_col]]), width = 8, pad = "0")
  )

huc_centroids <- huc_boundaries |>
  st_point_on_surface() |>
  mutate(
    lon = st_coordinates(geometry)[, 1],
    lat = st_coordinates(geometry)[, 2]
  ) |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  select(huc, lon, lat)

annual_spatial <- annual_slopes |>
  left_join(huc_centroids, by = "huc") |>
  filter(!is.na(lon), !is.na(lat)) |>
  mutate(
    lat_bin_id = ntile(lat, 10),
    lon_bin_id = ntile(lon, 10)
  ) |>
  group_by(lat_bin_id) |>
  mutate(
    lat_bin = sprintf("%.1f to %.1f°N", min(lat), max(lat))
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  group_by(lon_bin_id) |>
  mutate(
    lon_bin = sprintf("%.1f to %.1f°W", abs(max(lon)), abs(min(lon)))
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(
    lat_bin = factor(lat_bin, levels = unique(lat_bin[order(lat_bin_id)])),
    lon_bin = factor(lon_bin, levels = unique(lon_bin[order(lon_bin_id)]))
  )

```

```{r 6.1}

huc_centroids_sf <- huc_centroids |>
  st_as_sf(coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326)

huc_centroids_vect <- terra::vect(huc_centroids_sf)

worldclim_bio <- geodata::worldclim_global(
  var = "bio",
  res = 10,
  path = tempdir()
)

worldclim_elev <- geodata::elevation_global(
  res = 10,
  path = tempdir()
)

huc_covariates <- huc_centroids |>
  bind_cols(
    tibble(
      mat_c = terra::extract(worldclim_bio[["wc2.1_10m_bio_1"]], huc_centroids_vect, ID = FALSE)[, 1] / 10,
      map_mm = terra::extract(worldclim_bio[["wc2.1_10m_bio_12"]], huc_centroids_vect, ID = FALSE)[, 1],
      elev_m = terra::extract(worldclim_elev, huc_centroids_vect, ID = FALSE)[, 1]
    )
  ) |>
  select(huc, mat_c, map_mm, elev_m)

```

### Compare distributions by latitude / longitude

#### Latitude bins

**My read:** higher variability in mid-latitudes

```{r 7}

p_lat_violin <- annual_spatial |>
  ggplot(aes(x = lat_bin, y = annual_slope, fill = metabolism)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
  geom_violin(alpha = 0.75, scale = "width", trim = TRUE, position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)) +
  stat_summary(
    fun = median,
    geom = "point",
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    size = 1.4,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "D", end = 0.85) +
  labs(
    title = "Latitudinal gradients in annual HUC8 scaling slopes",
    x = "Latitude bin",
    y = "Median annual allometric slope",
    fill = "Flux"
  ) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1)
  )

p_lat_violin

ggsave(
  file.path(dir_figs, "07_latitude_bin_annual_slope_violin.png"),
  p_lat_violin,
  width = 9,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 300
)
```

#### GPP slope - ER slope

**My read:** positive values are autotrophic, scattered; negative values are heterotrophic, cluster in NE

```{r 9}

annual_slopes_wide <- annual_slopes |>
  select(huc, metabolism, annual_slope) |>
  mutate(huc = str_pad(as.character(huc), width = 8, pad = "0")) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = metabolism,
    values_from = annual_slope,
    names_prefix = "slope_"
  ) |>
  mutate(slope_gap = slope_GPP - slope_ER)

annual_map <- huc_boundaries |>
  mutate(huc = str_pad(as.character(huc), width = 8, pad = "0")) |>
  left_join(annual_slopes_wide, by = "huc")

annual_map |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  summarise(
    n_hucs = n(),
    n_slope_gpp = sum(!is.na(slope_GPP)),
    n_slope_er = sum(!is.na(slope_ER)),
    n_with_slope_gap = sum(!is.na(slope_gap))
  )

p_slope_gap_map <- annual_map |>
  ggplot() +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = slope_gap), color = NA) +
scale_fill_gradient2(
  low = "#2166ac",
  mid = "white",
  high = "#b2182b",
  midpoint = 0,
  limits = c(-0.30, 0.30),
  oob = scales::squish
) + 
  coord_sf(datum = NA) +
  labs(title = "Spatial pattern in annual GPP–ER scaling slope difference") +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

p_slope_gap_map

ggsave(
  file.path(dir_figs, "07_annual_gpp_er_slope_gap_map.png"),
  p_slope_gap_map,
  width = 10,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300
)

```


#### Seasonal variability (as standard deviation)

**My read:** clearly highest in E US and California for GPP, less clear patterns for ER

```{r 10}

seasonal_slopes <- allometry |>
  mutate(
    season = case_when(
      month %in% c("Dec", "Jan", "Feb") ~ "Winter",
      month %in% c("Mar", "Apr", "May") ~ "Spring",
      month %in% c("Jun", "Jul", "Aug") ~ "Summer",
      month %in% c("Sep", "Oct", "Nov") ~ "Fall"
    ),
    season = factor(season, levels = c("Winter", "Spring", "Summer", "Fall"))
  ) |>
  group_by(huc, metabolism, season) |>
  summarise(
    seasonal_slope = median(slope, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

seasonal_slope_sd <- seasonal_slopes |>
  group_by(huc, metabolism) |>
  summarise(
    slope_sd = sd(seasonal_slope, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_seasons = n_distinct(season),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  filter(n_seasons == 4)

seasonal_sd_map <- huc_boundaries |>
  mutate(huc = str_pad(as.character(huc), width = 8, pad = "0")) |>
  left_join(seasonal_slope_sd, by = "huc") |>
  filter(!is.na(metabolism), !is.na(slope_sd))

p_seasonal_sd_map <- seasonal_sd_map |>
  ggplot() +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = slope_sd), color = NA) +
  facet_wrap(~ metabolism, nrow = 1) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    option = "C",
    trans = "sqrt",
    limits = c(0, 0.15),
    oob = scales::squish,
    name = "Seasonal\nslope SD"
  ) +
  coord_sf(datum = NA) +
  labs(title = "Seasonal variability in HUC8 allometric scaling slopes") +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

p_seasonal_sd_map

ggsave(
  file.path(dir_figs, "07_seasonal_slope_sd_map.png"),
  p_seasonal_sd_map,
  width = 10,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300
  
)

```

## Some potential large-scale environmental factors

### Mean annual temperature

**My read:** less variability in slopes at lower temperatures

```{r}

annual_climate <- annual_slopes |>
  left_join(huc_covariates, by = "huc") |>
  filter(!is.na(mat_c)) |>
  mutate(
    mat_bin_id = ntile(mat_c, 10)
  ) |>
  group_by(mat_bin_id) |>
  mutate(
    mat_bin = sprintf("%.1f to %.1f °C", min(mat_c), max(mat_c))
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(
    mat_bin = factor(mat_bin, levels = unique(mat_bin[order(mat_bin_id)]))
  )

p_mat_violin <- annual_climate |>
  ggplot(aes(x = mat_bin, y = annual_slope, fill = metabolism)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
  geom_violin(alpha = 0.75, scale = "width", trim = TRUE, position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)) +
  stat_summary(
    fun = median,
    geom = "point",
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    size = 1.4,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "D", end = 0.85) +
  labs(
    title = "Annual HUC8 scaling slopes across mean annual temperature",
    x = "Mean annual temperature bin",
    y = "Median annual allometric slope",
    fill = "Flux"
  ) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1)
  )

p_mat_violin

ggsave(
  file.path(dir_figs, "07_mat_bin_annual_slope_violin.png"),
  p_mat_violin,
  width = 9,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 300
)

```
